༄༅/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyi bkra shis dge legs rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyi bkra shis dge legs rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swa sti/ bde legs su gyur cig /dpal ldan phyogs kun dge legs sbyin mdzad pa/ /mkha' dbyings rab gang rgyal ba sras bcas dang*/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyis/ /shin tu dges pa'i spyan ni rab phye nas/ kha cig me tog char 'bebs rnga chen brdung*/ /gzhan dag bkra shis glu len mchod pa byed/ khro bo lha mor bcas pas bar chad bsrung*/ khyed la gnas 'dir rtag tu dge legs stsol/ / dpal ldan rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang mchog gis 'gro ba smin zhing grol bar mdzad pa rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo 'khor lo'i mgon po dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag po rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa rnams la dge legs kyi mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba'i bkra shis dam pa des/ skal pa dang ldan pa gang dag 'dir 'khod pa rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i khams gsum gyi skye 'gro thams cad srid pa dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs kyi dpal la gnas pas lhag par skyong bar gyur cig / rgyal ba dbang phyug brgyad ldan 'khor lo sdom/ rnal 'byor ma dpal gsang ba'i bdag po dang*/ /sa ra ha dang klu sgrub shā bā ri/ /lū yi pa dang da ri ḍeṅge pa/ /rdo rje dril bu pa dang rus sbal zhabs/ /dzā lan+dha ra nag po spyod pa dang*/ /gu h+ya rnam rgyal zhabs dang til+li pa/ /nā ro pa sogs bla ma dam pa la/ /byin rlabs dge legs mtshan ma ci mnga' bas/ /bla ma dam pa'i rnam thar ji lta ba/ /'dzin zhing rim gnyis lam gyis mchog grub nas/ /gsang sngags bstan pa rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / thar pa chen po gzhal yas khang gi snying po'i sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar nyin mor byed pa la/ 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi gdan la/ mchog tu mdzes pa'i mtshan dang dpe byad rab tu 'bar ba in+d+ra nī li'i lhun po la nyin mor byed pa'i 'od zer 'bum gyis 'khyud pa lta bu dbang phyug brgyad dang yon tan brgyad dang yan lag bdun dang ro myang brgyad la sogs pa yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa'i ston pa phun sum tshogs pa bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum la shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i dge legs kyi mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba'i bkra shis dam pa des skal pa dang ldan pa gang dag 'dir 'khod pa rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i khams gsum gyi skye 'gro thams cad srid pa dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs kyi dpal la gnas pas lhag par skyong bar gyur cig

/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba'i//he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/ /shes rab phag mo'i pad+mar rdo rje rol mdzad pa'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog / bde ba'i mchog gyur he ru ka dpal dang*/ /bde ster shes rab ma mchog rnal 'byor ma/ /bde stong dpyid thig zung 'jug sbyor ba'i mchog /bde chen 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum la/ /dge legs mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba des/ /mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / thub pa chen po'i chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi snying po rab dang mchog tu gyur pa/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud bye ba phrag bcu drug gi gtso bo grub pa'i rtog pa rmad du byung ba/ dpa' bo chen po bklags pas 'grub pa/ thams cad du gzhan gyis mi thub pa gdod nas grub brgyud thams cad kyi bla ma/ dpal he ru ka rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rtsa ba'i rgyud dang*/ bshad pa'i rgyud dang*/ yan lag gi rgyud dang bcas pa la shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i dge legs kyi mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba'i bkra shis dam pa des/ skal pa dang ldan pa gang dag 'dir 'khod pa rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i khams gsum gyi skye 'gro thams cad srid pa dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs kyi dpal la gnas pas lhag par skyong bar gyur cig / bde ba che mchog rab 'byams rtogs pa dang*/ /dbang dang rim gnyis mtha' yas rab ston pa/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi snying po ni/ /dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud sde la/ /dge legs mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba des/ / mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / rab 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' klas par sgrub pa po la dngos sgrub rtsol zhing gtso bo nyid dang thugs kyi ye shes mi gnyis pa/

dpa' bo chen po gzugs rdo rje dang*/ dpa' bo chen po tshor ba rdo rje dang*/ dpa' bo chen po 'du shes rdo rje dang*/ dpa' bo chen po 'du byed rdo rje dang*/ dpa' bo chen po rnam shes rdo rje dang*/ dpa' bo chen po chos kyi dbyings de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtso bo rdo rje dang*/ dpa' bo chen po mig rdo rje dang*/ dpa' bo chen po rna ba rdo rje dang*/ dpa' bo chen po sna rdo rje dang*/ dpa' bo chen po lce rdo rje dang*/ dpa' bo chen po lus rdo rje dang*/ dpa' bo chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang phyug rdo rje dang*/ rnal 'byor ma chen mo ltung byed ma dang*/ rnal 'byor ma chen mo gsod byed ma dang*/ rnal 'byor ma chen mo 'gugs byed ma dang*/ rnal 'byor ma chen mo pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma dang*/ rnal 'byor ma chen po pad+ma dra ba can dang*/ gzhan yang rab 'byams zhing kun gyi rdul snyed dang mnyam pa'i yum bzhi dang gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams dang*/ ma mo rnams dang*/ go cha'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi rigs su gnas pa thams cad kyang hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs pa mdzes pa'i gar sna tshogs pa byed cing*/ rang gi dam tshig dang 'khyud pa dang tsum pa sogs snying rje chen po'i nyams yongs su rdzogs par mdzad cing phung po dang khams dang skye mched dang*/ rtsa dang*/ khams dang*/ rlung byin gyis rlabs nas/ lam gyi grogs mdzad pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams la shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i dge legs kyi mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba'i bkra shis dam pa des skal pa dang ldan pa gang dag 'dir 'khod pa rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i khams gsum gyi skye 'gro thams cad srid pa dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs kyis dpal la gnas pa'i lhag par skyong bar gyur cig phung khams skye mched byin gyis rlobs pa'i lha/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje la sogs lha rnams dang*/

/bgegs kun 'joms shing ting 'dzin dam pa las/ /g.yo ba med mdzad go cha'i lha rnams la/ /dge legs mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba des/ /mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig sna tshogs pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ /rigs ky-i yum bzhi dpa' bo'i phyogs bzhi'i zhal la gzigs/ /pad+ma'i mu khyud gri gug phreng bas rnam par mdzes/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /mkha' 'gro lā ma dum skyes gzugs can ma/ /dam tshig can 'dus brtse ba'i rjes bzung nas/ /yon tan ma lus skyed pa'i grogs mdzad ma/ /bsam pa tsam gyis bde ster yul bzhi la/ /dge legs mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba des/ /mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig mtshams kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ /byang chub sems dang tsan dan dri chen gur gum chus/ /gang ba'i snod bzhis dpa' bo'i zhal la reg par spyod/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /ye shes bdud rtsi lnga yis rnam gang ba/ /thabs kyi rang bzhin rdo rje dam tshig snod/ /rab tu bsten na ye shes lus su 'gyur/ /byang sems 'phel ba'i dngos grub sbyin rnams la/ /dge legs mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba des/ /mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig nam mkha'i gnas na legs spyod pa'i/ /'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud rdo rje'i phreng*/ /gnas la sogs par dpa' bo dpa' mo gnyis med rol/ / bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /thugs kyi rigs gyur pho nya gsum 'dus las/ /'od gsal dga' ston sbyin mdzad nam mkha'

spyod/ /gnas dang nye gnas dpa' bo lha mo la/ /dge legs mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba des/ /mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig sa steng gnas na legs spyod pa'i/ /'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud pad+ma'i 'phreng*/ /zhing la sogs par dpa' bo dpa' mor gnyis med rol/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /gsung gi rigs gyur pho nya gsum 'dus las/ /'od gsal dga' ston sbyin mdzad sa steng spyod/ /zhing dang 'dun rtog nye bar bcas pa yi/ /dpa' bo lha mor dge legs ci mnga' bas/ /mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig sa 'og gnas na legs spyod pa'i/ /'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud 'khor lo'i 'phreng*/ /'du la sogs par dpa' bo dpa' mo gnyis med rol/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /sku'i rigs gyur pho nya gsum 'dus las/ /'od gsal dga' ston sbyin mdzad sa 'og spyod/ /'du dang dur khrod nye bar bcas pa yi/ /dpa' bo lha mor dge legs ci mnga' bas/ /mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi mtshams rnams su/ khā gdong la sogs ma mo yid 'phrog gzugs gnyis ldan/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad gdug pa kun 'dul ba'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /rta yi rgyal po'i rigs mchog las kun dang*/ /dngos grub thams cad thogs pa med par bsgrub/ /lam gyi bar gcod gdug pa thams cad 'dul/ /rab song gnas brgyad pho nyas bde ster ma/

/rdo rje ma mor dge legs ci mnga' bas/ /mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / de ltar dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum gyi bzhugs pa'i gnas phun sum tshogs pa dkyil 'khor chen po bzhi la gnas pa'i ri'i rgyal po lhun po rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i steng na rdo rje rin po che'i gzhal yas khang rgyan dang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'od ltar 'bar ba'i dpag tshad bye bar khyab pa/ dril bu dpyangs pa'i sgra las yan lag dgu dang ldan pa/ rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo gzhom du med pa'i dbyangs la 'jug pa'i sgra sgrog pa/ srung ba'i 'khor los bskor ba'i phyir rol sna tshogs pa'i lha dang*/ klu dang*/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ 'byung po rnams dang mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro phaiṃ zhes pa dang*/ a la la'i sgra sgrogs pa/ dril bu dang*/ cang te'u'i sgra dang mchod rdzas rnams kyis gang ba'i mchog tu rmad du byung ba chen po dang bcas pa la shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i dge legs kyi mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba'i bkra shis dam pa des/ skal pa dang ldan pa gang dag 'dir 'khod pa rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i khams gsum gyi skye 'gro thams cad srid pa dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs kyi dpal la gnas pas lhag par skyong bar gyur cig /bkra shis gang zhig dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi rnams dang*/ yang dag spong dang rdzu 'phrul rkang pa dbang po sogs/ byang chub phyogs chos sum cu rtsa bdun yongs rdzogs pa'i/ bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog / bkra shis gang zhig rin chen pha gus mdzes pa'i steng*/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lngas ni rab tu brgyan gyur cig /mu tig nyi zla rin chen gser gyi dril bu dpyangs/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog

/bkra shis gang zhig rta babs pad+ma 'khor lo gdugs/ /ri dwags dang bcas mdzes pa'i ba dan bcu drug 'phyar/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i dril bu chos kyi sgra sgrogs pa/ / bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bcu gnyis sa yi rang bzhin 'khor lo lnga/ /rab yangs pho brang dam pa gzhal med khang*/ /rin chen rgyan rnams kun ldan snang byed gtso/ /bcom ldan rtag pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa la/ /dge legs mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba des/ /mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig yongs bskor dur khrod brgyan rnams su/ phyogs skyong brgyad dang shing chen brgyad ni gnas pa la/ /gdong brnyan dang ldan zhing skyong brgyad ni gnas gyur pa'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig ye shes me brgyad rab 'bar zhing*/ /byang chub sems kyi sprin chen brgyad ni 'dus gyur la/ /dga' bo la sogs klu chen brgyad ni gnas gyur pa'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig thugs rje'i chu chen brgyad 'bab cing*/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi gang*/ /sha za srin po 'byung po'i tshogs kyi nyer bsten pa/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba gur/ /bla res kun nas bris shing mda' yi dra bar ldan/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i kun nas yongs bskor ba'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /rnam shes brgyad kyi srid pa spangs pa las/ /dur khrod brgyad po nyer spyod yongs rdzogs pa/ /dkyil 'khor pa kun mchod cing las kun sgrub/ /sgrub la zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las/ /sbyin mdzad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag yas kyis/

/mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /mi phyed bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dam pa ni/ /rnam par thar pa bzhi yi bdag nyid can/ /bdud dpung 'joms pa'i ye shes me lcer bcas/ /rdo rje bsrung 'khor rab tu brtan pa la/ /dge legs mtshan ma ji snyed mnga' ba des/ /mi mthun kun zhi phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas/ /chos kun lhan skyes rab 'byams sdom pa'i mchog /rang gzhan phan bde rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / 'di la spro na rdzogs pa 'di byas la/ de nas gzhan yang rgyal ba'i bka' las byung ba'i bkra shis zhig gi thog drangs te ci rigs shig bya'o/ /mi spro na tshig lhug rnams bor te tshigs bcad kho nas kyang rung ngo*/ /zhes bram ze rin chen rdo rje'i bkra shis dang spel mar sbyar ba 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyi bkra shis dge legs rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gsum la snron gyi zla ba'i yar tshes bcu bzhi la sbyar ba'o// //zhus dgabakra shis//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyi bkra shis dge legs rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 330--PAGE 331--PAGE 323-
